about: Qualification 1 of DDD-dec-73 (Round 3, 2026-10-30): RDFC-1.0 over RDF 1.2 canonical N-Quads. Each case is one N-Triples line in, and the canonical line out, as Varve at 4dea5a7 writes it: Varve.Turtle/Escapes.cs (ECHAR for BS, HT, LF, FF, CR, quote and backslash; UCHAR with uppercase hex for the other C0 controls, DEL, U+FFFE and U+FFFF; every other character as itself) and docs/spec/rdf-canon.md ('a language tag is written in lowercase'). Expected values were written from those sources before any tool was run against them. The cases 'tab' and 'language-tag' are the two Round 3 named.
